answers.explanation: Two forms of the same data let you detect when one has been changed.
Start-up, idle, normal, busy, failing, failed.
80% is fine when busy and alarming when idle. That's why ranges are set per meta-state.
Failing: degrading, not yet stopped. Catching it here is how you avoid failed.
Holidays, weekends, workdays, and time of year. An IP address isn't a time.
Rebuilding from partial information is data rapidity, the same idea as RAID 5's parity.
It should never change. If it does, something is wrong with the data or the sensor.
A slow drift fools a baseline that keeps adjusting, but not a comparison with last year's same week.
